subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Should this PR require live visible generated-media fallback proof before merge, or is the current scheduler/internal-path proof acceptable for this internal wake-false boundary?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and covered by focused tests, but the available Mantis artifact explicitly skips normal Telegram Desktop behavior and does not show an observed user-visible before/after result.

options.title: Require live fallback proof
options.body: Keep the PR paused until a proof stack, live gateway run, terminal transcript, logs, or Telegram artifact shows baseline missing or blocking the generated media and candidate delivering exactly once.

options.title: Accept internal-path proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the scheduler matrix and internal Mantis fixed marker as sufficient while owning the remaining live-channel uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind proof harness
options.body: Keep this implementation draft waiting on the linked proof-harness or stacked proof target to produce the missing baseline/candidate evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live fallback proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR paused until a proof stack, live gateway run, terminal transcript, logs, or Telegram artifact shows baseline missing or blocking the generated media and candidate delivering exactly once.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work on media requester route safety makes this the best available routing candidate for deciding proof sufficiency around generated-media delivery.
